author: ChaoticDemise
body:
Looks like you are a T8 class Nekromancer. The best advice i can really give you is level up. 10-15k isn't bad for t8, but once you hit T9 and get omnimancer that will help a lot. Other options are going Grand attuner T8/summoner T9.
Once you get T10, things really start to fall into place as far as small tweaks to increase damage. Not saying you can't do it before T10 but working on getting through to T10 should be the I tail goal as after that there a lot of options and playstyles as you gather gear you will not out level. If you have any specific questions, even for the lower teirs, feel free to DM.

author: arusinoff

author: eudaimoniazeno
body:
I think a higher damage cap is not possible at your tier. Once you step at tier 9, you will deal a higher damage compared to tier 8 classes. There's a lot of factors including higher quality gear which may boost your stats, celestial classes to unlock decent skills, adornments, titan augments.

You are still in the 70-80% of your game progress, endgame will happen once you step to tier 10-11.

author: Powerful-Owl6899
body: Once you hit t9, focus on towers as much as possible. They will give a lot of xp and the tower shards are very important as a t10. You will want to save up ~370k if possible (enough for class and maxed weapon) before you hit 225. You aren't doing bad at all. A lot of the damage doesn't come until your gear gets better in end game. Summoner is an easy class, but has one of the highest quit rates. The gameplay is pretty boring, and once you get into t10 it loses viability quickly. You can slow roll things, but it is way less efficient in raids, which can be frustrating since t8-t9 it is the best damage output by a wide margin with basically no investment.
